edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner() in mint's require to gate minting.
msg.sender is passed as the recipient to _safeMint, triggering a receiver callback.
msg.sender becomes the transfer destination in withdraw.
_msgSender() (msg.sender) is forwarded into the onERC721Received callback.
block.timestamp is consumed by getCurrentYear, making output time dependent.
_msgSender simply returns msg.sender feeding the ownership checks.
owner() is compared with _msgSender() in the onlyOwner modifier.
getCurrentYear calls timestamp2year.
makeArt calls getCurrentYear, inheriting timestamp dependence.
timestamp2year calls leapYearsBefore.
timestamp2year calls isLeapYear within its adjustment loop.
tokenURI calls makeArt to produce SVG art data.
tokenURI reads _ogs[tokenId] to render metadata.
_setOGs writes the OG year value into the _ogs mapping.
mint calls _setOGs to store the requested OG years.
mint calls _safeMint which may invoke an external receiver callback.
mint increments totalSupply after minting.
mint reads mintingActive to decide whether minting is permitted.
mint increments artBalance for msg.sender.
mint calls owner() in the paused-minting bypass check.
_safeMint calls _mint to create the token.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received call on the recipient.
The recipient contract can re-enter the minting/transfer flow via the callback.
_transfer decrements/increments _balances.
_transfer updates the _owners mapping to the new owner.
_mint increments _balances[to].
_mint assigns _owners[tokenId].
_burn decrements _balances[owner].
_burn deletes _owners[tokenId].
withdraw performs the ETH transfer to msg.sender via the unsafe operation.
royaltyInfo reads and returns _royaltiesReceiver.
setRoyaltiesReceiver writes the privileged _royaltiesReceiver state.
setMintingActive writes the mintingActive flag.
constructor sets the initial _royaltiesReceiver.
Ownable constructor calls _msgSender to assign initial ownership.
noYears parameter flows into mint.
amount parameter flows into withdraw.
amount is the value sent in the payable transfer.
newRoyaltiesReceiver parameter flows into setRoyaltiesReceiver.
isMintingActive parameter flows into setMintingActive.
_tokenId parameter flows into royaltyInfo.
_salePrice is multiplied by royaltiesPercentage to compute the royalty amount.
numberOs parameter flows into makeArt.
timestamp parameter flows into timestamp2year.
someone local variable is the recipient of the payable transfer.
yearCalc local variable drives makeArt color/branch logic.
noYears is forwarded from mint into _setOGs as the stored OG value.
